title: Shell
description: Layout primitives that dock blocks into a dense tool: Pane, PaneHeader, Toolbar and Section, with resizable and collapsible pane groups.
docs: Render every block inside a Pane: a PaneHeader and a Toolbar at its top, the rest in a PaneContent, which scrolls. Dock panes in a PaneGroup (orientation horizontal or vertical), which needs a parent with a height; a pane can hold another PaneGroup. Put a PaneHandle between two panes to let the user resize them. Pane takes react-resizable-panels' Panel props: numbers for defaultSize, minSize and maxSize are pixels, and collapsible gives its PaneHeader a collapse button. Set side="end" on a pane docked to the right or bottom. Set density on a PaneGroup or Pane for everything inside it: comfortable for data entry, compact for lists and inspectors. Sizes come from the --dhis2-control-h, --dhis2-row-h, --dhis2-pane-pad, --dhis2-gap and --dhis2-text tokens; do not add heights, font sizes, padding, radius, cards or shadows around a pane's content. Give a Toolbar at most one primary ToolbarButton. PaneHeader and Section take a title for the plain case; to put anything else in one, such as a count, leave title out and compose it: PaneHeader from a PaneTitle (which names the collapse button), any other content and a PaneActions; Section from a SectionTrigger holding any content and a SectionContent (flush drops its padding). To restyle a primitive pass className, which wins over its own classes; reach a part inside it by its data-slot (pane-title, pane-actions, pane-toggle, section-heading, section-trigger, section-indicator, section-title, section-meta, section-content), as in className="[&_[data-slot=pane-title]]:text-dhis2-foreground".
